decisions.why: LumboTrain and Breg Spinal are lumbar/spinal orthoses; T-Scope Hip and Arc 2.0 are general limb (hip/knee) braces, so evidence spans two orthotics types.
ActivaScrew Cannulated/Interference TCP are knee ligament reconstruction screws and Osteochondral Allograft is implanted tissue - orthopaedic implants.
Categories list Interbody Fusion Devices, Anterior Plating and Posterior Stabilisation Systems; PROSPACE 3D examples are interbody fusion cages - spinal implant hardware.
ActivaNail, Episealer Talus, AMIC/Chondro-Gide Knee and ProChondrix CR are all orthopaedic extremity implants/cartilage repair implants.
Sole example is 'Run Performance Insoles (Arch Support)', a direct match to Insoles and footcare.
